details:
This feedback request is multiple in one, but I see all of these as part of the same feature release and required for each one to work together.

This is a feedback request asking to **reduce the 5 second requests, allow runtime URL generation, and allow all types of requests** (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, etc) for worlds.

However, this is combined with a request for VRChat to allow the **VRC API in Worlds to be locked down further** and **gated behind user permissions**. For example, web requests can be unrestricted, but world API access (usernames, player data, etc.) will be restricted as a result.

This is brought up because of this recent post showing that **Popcorn Palace was previously exporting usernames one request at a time**.

https://bsky.app/profile/arti.gay/post/3my6uhjxoas2n

This is also something I've hypothesized about before of how I can export information from VRChat by preemptively baking tens or hundreds of thousands of URLs for combos of data.

If something as visible as Popcorn Palace was doing this, **I can only imagine all the other worlds that have figured out how to do this type of thing**. And it's not even necessarily for malicious purposes. Apparently the Popcorn Palace one was done to improve a feature in the world that was intended to improve user experience.

If VRChat simply allowed worlds to do web requests however they want, but also had a feature to disable parts of the VRC API if users do not want to share that information, it would at least allow a **more efficient pathway that can be actively monitored and checked for security** rather than having to squash bugs like this. Especially if VRChat had an **easier way to view web requests** instead of relying on the logs or external apps like VRCX.

As an example, VRChat could implement static analysis for Udon code, which would allow them to see which types of data are being accessed and piped into requests.

Here are also some of my previous feature requests, including one that was tracked, and one that talks about a **pathway for expanded API access**:

https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/change-rate-limit-for-imagestring-loading

https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/custom-url-whitelist

https://feedback.vrchat.com/udon/p/verification-pathway-for-expanded-world-api-access
title: Allow Full URL API Access and Add User Permission Scopes
